test_title: PYST 51: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Mary appeared for the test. She was __waiting anxiously__ for the test result.

options.text: hitting the nail on the head

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"on pins and needles"** means to be in a state of anxious suspense or nervous anticipation. (बेचैनी या तनावपूर्ण प्रतीक्षा में होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was on pins and needles waiting for the results of her job interview.
 
 
 
• The sentence describes Mary as anxiously awaiting her test results, which aligns perfectly with the meaning of "on pins and needles". (बेचैनी से इंतजार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Mary appeared for the test and was on pins and needles waiting for the outcome.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A piece of cake **(बहुत आसान काम): Refers to something that is very easy to do.

 
 
• **Example:** Solving that math problem was a piece of cake for her.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Hitting the nail on the head **(बिलकुल सही बात कहना): Refers to expressing something accurately or doing something perfectly.
 
 
• **Example:** You really hit the nail on the head with your analysis of the situation.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Jumping through hoops **(कठिन प्रयास करना): Refers to going through a lot of effort or difficulties to achieve something.
 
 
• **Example:** I had to jump through hoops to get the approval for this project.
 
 

30:Td06,

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To be supportive in both good and bad times.
